reports.title: Moisture in timber facades after three winters
reports.abstract: Sixty-four probes in the larch facade of Hallmark Library show where three subarctic winters actually left their moisture.

reports.title: What 400 million points cannot tell you
reports.abstract: A dense scan records geometry with great precision and says almost nothing about material, cause or change. This is how we fill the gaps.

reports.title: Daylight autonomy versus occupant comfort

reports.title: Drift in a ten-year slab

reports.title: Thirty years of drawings, one query
